content: Yɛsu anà Nàkàdim
Kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy kiböl a Amfarisi ikɔb ande Nàkàdim. Nde kàkäl umwɛy uboo a amfum a Ayudà.

Nde kàyi u mpib akà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Rabi, bi ikyàyöb naa ngye awà un'lɔɔŋ an'fà akà Nzam, ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukyer idiim asànaa afàkyer ngye, isàkal naa uboo ande Nzam watɛy. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: Isàkal naa mbuur bun'bör anki wàkün, nde ukwe anki muman Imwol a Nzam. »
Nàkàdim kun'fuul naa: « Nkye mbuur aŋànün kan'kwo bàfun'bɔr mbalà asin? Nkye nde kan'kwo ufàbilà mbalà yàyweel kà an'bäl a ngwän waa bàfun'bɔr? »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam, isàkal naa nde bun'bör anki kà an'dà anà u Dweelà.
Ayà ban'bɔr unsà un'sön yà un'sön, ayà ban'bɔr unsà Dweelà, yà dweelà.
Twon an'bem isàkal naa mɛ an'tɛn a ngye naa: "Yan'kwo naa bàfabɔr mböör a du."
Un'pöb afàful mper ayà ukwen wa. Ngye awem làso awa, wɛɛ ngye ayöb anki naa wa kan'fà ken, itàkal naa wa sye akyà ken. Ayi yà ndaa ifàlyaaŋ uboo a mbuur wanswà awà ban'bɔr u Dweelà. »
Apan Nàkàdim kun'fuul naa: « Ndaa ayi yan'kwo mukal aben? »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Ngye, ngye awà un'lɔɔŋ atoo làpan kà Isàlɛl, waa ngye indiir abi ayöb anki!
Ndandaa, ndandaa, mɛ akyään: bi ifàtɛn ya iyöb bi, bi ifàtà imbäl a yakwà kàmɛn bi. Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkwen anki làkyey imbäl abi.
Isàkal naa bɛ làkakyeyà anki mpal alàkyäänà mɛ indiir a mɛɛn, bɛ làyàkyey aben isàkal naa mɛ amàlakyään indiir a du?
Ntɔn, akà mbuur ŋàtàbeenà anki du, nà Mwan a mbuur mpɛl awà kàfü du.
Asànaa Mɔsɛ kàmbaar nde ntäy u nsye a ipɔl, abun sye bàsàmbaar Mwan a mbuur,
ntɔn mbuur wanswà asà làkwikilà amu nde, ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Abun Nzam kàkwen mɛɛn mbɔɔn, lalan kàpɛ nde Mwan baal ande mwɛy mpɛl, ntɔn mbuur wanswà asà làkwikilà amu nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akyà bwà, wɛɛ nde ukäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Ntɔn Nzam kàtöm anki Mwan baal ande u mɛɛn ntɔn mudwa mbuur ndwà, wɛɛ ntɔn mɛɛn iwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a nde.
Mbuur afàsà nde làkwikilà bun'tsüül anki nsaŋ. Mbuur mpa afàsà làkwikilà, bàkyun'tsüül mbar itaan, ntɔn nde kàsi anki làkwikilà amu ikɔb a Mwan baal mwɛy mpɛl a Nzam.
Nsaŋ ya yi: pɛɛlà làyi u mɛɛn, wɛɛ baar bàkwen làpib kà ikal a pɛɛlà, ntɔn nsyääl aba yàkäl yàmbe.
Abun, mbuur wanswà afàkyer ube, nde kan'tɔn pɛɛlà anà nde sye kan'kaabà anà la, manà nsyääl ambe ande iyàmɛnà u leŋ.
Mbuur wanswà afàkyer ndandaa, nde afàyà ntsü awà pɛɛlà, ntɔn nsyääl ande amu Nzam imɛnà u leŋ. »
Yɛsu anà Ywan
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkyen Yuday anà alɔŋki ande. Nde kàbwaay kwo anà ba anà kàpɛɛ ndüümà.
Ywan sye kàpɛɛ ndümà u Ɛnɔ tsütsü a Salim, ntɔn an'dà màkäl mbɔɔn kwo. Baar bàyee akà nde, waa bàwɛlà ndüümà.
Ntɔn Ywan kàkäl anki aŋàtàbilà bɔlokà.
Kyekà, nsyeel a mbaaŋ yàkyer abwà uboo a alɔŋki a Ywan anà Un'yudà mwɛy unsà ndaa iler mpɔɔŋà a ndür.

Ba bàyàman Ywan, waa bun'fuul naa: « Rabi, mbuur akwà kàkälà anà ngye u sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy, nde akwà kàtɛɛlà ngye imbäl, le nde sye wàmupaa ndüümà anà baar banswà bàkyeenà akà nde! »
Ywan kafuur naa: « Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki muwal undiir asin udu a undiir bun'pɛ fà du.
Bɛ, bɛ ŋakwo làbà ambäl amɛ mpal kàtɛn mɛ naa: "Mɛ, mɛ kà in'wà Klistɔ anki, wɛɛ mɛ in'wà mbuur bàtöm kusà a nde."
Mbuur awe anà un'kyay, nde wà un'dim. Wɛɛ akà un'sam ande afàkal ukɔl, wàmukun'wemà, ndaa a un'dim yàmukun'paa un'sak. Awà un'sak amɛ, wa wàŋàkwo.
Yubwaŋ naa nde uyɛl, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'tyà.
Mbuur kan'fà du
« Mbuur kan'fà du, wà udu a baar banswà. Mbuur awà u mɛɛn, wà mbuur a mɛɛn, ndaa ande yà ndaa a mɛɛn. Mbuur kan'fà du wà udu a baar banswà,
nde afàtà imbäl a indiir kàmɛn nde anà kàwem nde, wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy afàkyey imbäl ande watɛy.
Mbuur afàwal imbäl ande, kan'bɛɛrà inyɛm naa Nzam wà ndandaa.
Ntɔn mbuur kàtöm Nzam afàtɛn ndaa a Nzam, ntɔn nde afun'pà Dweelà aŋàkwo.
Taa akwen Mwan, waa kàpɛ indiir byanswà kà an'kɔɔ ande.
Mbuur afàsà làkwikilà ande amu Mwan, we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Mbuur mpa afàsà làkwikilà amu Mwan usàman anki mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nkyɛl a Nzam isàkal udu a nde. »
